LESSON: THE BIBLE STORY:

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Holy 2.4 Bible Story: By the end of the Sub strand, the ● Learners to read G
Topic 2.5: The Bible Story:

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The Bible Story:. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. acquire the skill of assertiveness by emulating Daniel in their lives 29
2. appreciate God as the protector by trusting in Him

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. acquire the skill of assertiveness by emulating Daniel in their lives 29
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to acquire the skill of assertiveness by emulating Daniel in their lives 29. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate God as the protector by trusting in Him
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate God as the protector by trusting in Him. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The Bible Story:.
2. Explain The Bible Story: to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Bible Story:.
4. Show that you can: acquire the skill of assertiveness by emulating Daniel in their lives 29
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Bible Story:. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is The Bible Story: important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. acquire the skill of assertiveness by emulating Daniel in their lives 29
2. appreciate God as the protector by trusting in Him

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
